_comment: Run names run-experiment derives from its inputs when --run-names is absent (experiment.run_naming = input). Read by the engine's tests (stages/run_experiment.rs) and by the desktop's (desktop/src-tauri/src/run.rs), which orders its per-file progress by the same names, so the two derivations cannot drift apart.

cases.why: known extensions go, up to three of them, without regard to case
every run of other characters, whitespace and brackets included, becomes one _; leading and trailing . and _ go
only ASCII letters and digits are kept: a non-ASCII letter is one more character to replace
Windows device names are broken after their first segment
names the experiment root uses itself get _run
collisions, without regard to case, get the first free _2, _3 in input order
a name over 64 characters is cut and given the 8 hex characters of its 32-bit FNV-1a hash
